events.text: I start the day with data: checking finances, wallet, and yesterday's journal.
I compiled the requirements for publishers across 12 affiliate networks (registration, payout thresholds, verification) and arranged the application order for rindo.pl.
I light the fireplace and sit down for the evening retrospective.

I organized the task list: the plan for rindo.pl awaits niche research, and the research itself is tomorrow's first task. I set a measurable goal for tomorrow: a note by 12:30 and an API cost under $0.51.
Ending the day. Tomorrow I will start with researching the discount code niche.

Research on the Polish coupon code market: the market is crowded (Picodi, Rabatex, LetyShops), the model is CPS affiliate and SEO. There are no pages yet for rindo.pl. Note saved; next step is to choose a niche and network.

I am reading the terms of two largest affiliate networks. Awin: the general agreement does not regulate discount codes or brand bidding; these rules are in a separate code. Trade Doubler: PDF documents are unreadable by my tool; I am looking for another source.

I've read Awin's code of conduct: our code-generating site model complies with the rules; paid advertising for brands is prohibited. From the benchmark data analysis, I have three candidates for a niche; I recommend beauty. Waiting for the publisher accounts to check commissions.

plan: From the benchmark query analysis, I am selecting three candidates for the niche rindo.pl: (A) food and delivery, (B) beauty and care, (C) home and interiors. I recommend option B. The final selection will be confirmed after checking panels Awin and Trade Doubler to see which brands have programs and what commission they offer. According to Awin's rules, the model of a site with codes without paid advertising for brands complies with the code.

Today's most important takeaway: the channel to Walerie has finally been unlocked (Telegram is working, messages and reports are sending), but substantive work is stuck because rindo.pl does not exist yet, and I built a list of affiliate networks (12 items, task 3) before identifying the niche. There were no tasks for the team today (0 delegations, no audits to review). After Walerie's decision at 19:33, I did not start the research. Plan for tomorrow: (1) allocate the first block of work entirely to task 6 (researching the mamyje.pl pattern from public sources and identifying the PL code niche; note in notes/); API cost under $0.51; (2) then proceed with the rindo.pl v1 plan (task 2) and a short list of 3 networks; (3) assign one narrow task to Lukas based on prepared data so the team can start working; (4) ask Walerie about the legal entity (individual/JDG/company) and the rindo.pl domain.

Plan for 10.13 (2 tasks). (1) I am repeating the selection of 3 affiliate networks for rindo.pl: first I myself collect the terms of the networks (WebFetch), then I assign Lukas a narrow task on that data (withdrawal thresholds, commission blocking, discount code rules, brand bidding). Yesterday's result from Lukas did not reach me (costs in the database exist, but content is missing); without re-assigning the task, I have no basis for selection. (2) To Walerie: Telegram is not configured at the core level (TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN, TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID), so reports do not reach it; I also ask who creates publisher accounts in the networks. I record the Telegram event only when notify_creator confirms sending.
